profilePresentation_avatarEditorBuild.en: Drag and pinch to zoom. What's inside the frame is your avatar.
profilePresentation_avatarEditorBuild.zh: 拖动、双指缩放，方框里的部分就是头像。

profilePresentation_avatarEditorLoopAvat.en: Avatar upload isn't open yet. Use the default for now.
profilePresentation_avatarEditorLoopAvat.zh: 头像上传暂未开放，先用默认头像。

profilePresentation_avatarMediaInvalidDa.en: Couldn't confirm the upload. Your avatar wasn't changed.
profilePresentation_avatarMediaInvalidDa.zh: 上传结果无法确认，头像没有更换。

profilePresentation_avatarMediaOffline.en: No network connection. Your avatar wasn't uploaded.
profilePresentation_avatarMediaOffline.zh: 网络未连接，头像没有上传。

profilePresentation_avatarMediaRateLimit.en: Too many uploads. Try again in a minute.
profilePresentation_avatarMediaRateLimit.zh: 上传太频繁，请一分钟后再试。

profilePresentation_avatarMediaRejected.en: This image can't be used: it must be JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 5 MB, at least 64 pixels per side.
profilePresentation_avatarMediaRejected.zh: 这张图片不能用：需要 JPG、PNG、WebP 或 HEIC，不超过 5 MB，边长至少 64 像素。

profilePresentation_avatarMediaUnavailab.en: Avatar upload isn't available right now. Use the default for now.
profilePresentation_avatarMediaUnavailab.zh: 头像上传暂不可用，先用默认头像。

profilePresentation_avatarMediaUnexpecte.zh: 头像没有上传成功，请重试。
